name: Alden Ottoman w/ Storage Beige
description: The Alden Ottoman with Storage in Beige is as clever as it is beautiful. Its distinctive three-layered silhouette makes a sculptural statement on its own, while hiding a wealth of smart functionality within. The removable top lifts away to reveal generous hidden storage — and flips over to reveal a smooth walnut finish circular surface, instantly transforming the ottoman into a stylish side table or tray top. An oak veneer base and warm beige fabric complete the look with natural warmth and understated elegance. A true multi-tasker for the modern living room.

name: Amadeo Ottoman Elephant Gray
description: The Amadeo Ottoman in Elephant Gray is a perfect complement to the Amadeo Modular Sectional Sofa, showcasing a seamless blend of luxury and functionality. Upholstered in premium Italian leather and plush cushioning, this ottoman exudes sophistication and timeless elegance. The Amadeo Ottoman also features a top storage compartment, providing a stylish solution for keeping your living space tidy and organized. Whether used as a footrest, additional seating, or a chic coffee table alternative, the Amadeo Ottoman enhances any living space with its refined design and versatile functionality. Also available in White and Light Gray.

description: Upholstered in Mocha Leather, the Bloom Ottoman is a vision of modern design. This ottoman can be added to any Bloom Sofa for added space or as an additional seat on its own.

description: Tailored in a sophisticated fabric, the Bloom Ottoman in white is a vision of modern design. This ottoman can be added to any Bloom Sofa for added space or as an additional seat on its own. Duck down cushion lends a plush softness with added support. The low-lying frame glides smoothly across floors to position where you please. Stylish and functional, the smart fabric upholstery is stain resistant, making spills easy to clean.

name: Boba Bench Beige Velvet
description: The Boba Bench in Beige Velvet is a modern masterpiece of minimalist elegance. Its sleek, rounded ends create a soft, sculptural silhouette that effortlessly complements contemporary spaces. Upholstered in luxurious beige velvet fabric, the bench exudes warmth and sophistication, offering a cozy yet refined aesthetic. Perfect for living rooms, bedrooms, or entryways, the Boba Bench combines style and functionality, serving as both a comfortable seating option and a striking design element.

name: Braxton Ottoman Cream
description: Add flare to your living room with the Braxton Ottoman in Cream. Crafted with art-deco inspired design, this functional statement piece adds drama to any space. This sleek design fits seamlessly into any Braxton sofa for added space and the appearance of a full sectional.

name: Brunello Ottoman Brown Velvet
description: Complete your Brunello Sectional with this matching ottoman, upholstered in the same luxurious brown velvet for a seamless, coordinated look. Its generously sized, plush cushioned top provides a comfortable footrest or extra seating, while the rounded edges and low-profile design echo the sectional's modern, cloud-like aesthetic. Perfect for propping up your feet, holding a tray, or expanding seating during gatherings, the Brunello Ottoman adds both style and versatility to your lounge area.

name: Elan Ottoman Beige
description: Soft, sculptural, and irresistibly inviting, the Elan Ottoman in Beige brings a plush, cushioned presence to any living space. Its smooth two-tiered rounded silhouette gives it a distinct, cloud-like character that works beautifully as a footrest, extra seat, or standalone accent piece. Upholstered in a warm beige fabric, it adds a cozy, organic softness that complements any sofa or lounge chair effortlessly. Small in footprint, big on personality

name: Loris Daybed Beige
description: Versatile and effortlessly elegant, the Loris Daybed in Beige is a generously proportioned upholstered bench that works as hard as it looks good. Fully upholstered in a soft beige fabric, its clean, low-profile form invites use at the foot of a bed, in a bedroom nook, at the end of a hallway, or as a relaxed lounging surface in a living space. A timeless, understated piece that adds warmth and intention to any room it occupies.

name: Marlo Ottoman Soft Ivory
description: Compact, charming, and effortlessly versatile, the Marlo Ottoman in Soft Ivory is a petite accent piece with plenty of personality. Fully upholstered in a soft ivory fabric, its rounded form sits on a sleek three-leg base that gives it a light, elevated presence — perfect as a footrest beside a lounge chair, extra perch for a guest, or a decorative accent in any room.

name: Rafael Ottoman Golden Cognac
description: The Rafael Ottoman in Golden Cognac is a beautifully composed accent piece that blends comfort and craftsmanship in equal measure. A plush, fabric-upholstered top in rich golden cognac sits atop a striking walnut-stained solid rubber wood X-shape base — a sculptural detail that elevates it well beyond a standard ottoman. The warm amber tone of the cognac fabric pairs naturally with the walnut base, creating a cohesive, luxurious look. Use it as a footrest, extra seat, or styled centerpiece in a living room arrangement.

name: Rafael Ottoman Soft Ivory
description: The Rafael Ottoman in Soft Ivory is a beautifully composed accent piece that blends comfort and craftsmanship in equal measure. A plush, fabric-upholstered round top in soft ivory sits atop a striking walnut-stained solid rubber wood X-shape base — a sculptural detail that elevates it well beyond a standard ottoman. Use it as a footrest, extra seat, or styled centerpiece in a living room arrangement. A refined finishing touch that brings warmth, texture, and considered design to any space.

name: Sacha Vanity Stool
description: The Sacha Vanity Stool is a beautifully crafted accent piece that combines elegance and everyday comfort in perfect measure. Its gracefully designed silhouette and premium upholstered seat make it as visually stunning as it is functional, sitting effortlessly at a vanity, dressing table, or as a chic accent in a bedroom or bathroom. Thoughtfully proportioned and impeccably finished, the Sacha brings a boutique hotel sensibility to the home.
